id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3995: "For my son's wedding, I was going to give a top-quality gold ring +1 or better, so I got gold ore as material.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39a3: "But thinking it over, a rough blacksmith like me can't make something as fancy as a ring.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39b0: "...What?! You're the one who can use the Fun-Sized Forge I've heard rumors about?!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39b8: "I heard the Fun-Sized Forge can make accessories too! Please, make a gold ring +1 or better in my place!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39cc: "Gah! How cold! Well, other people's weddings aren't fun anyway, I guess! Ha ha!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39e8: "Oh! You'll take it?! Then take gold ore from the chest next to me!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39f3: "And you'll need a gold ring recipe for the Fun-Sized Forge, so have this too.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39fe: "Use the materials in the recipe and do good work in the Fun-Sized Forge, and you can make a gold ring +1 or better.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a4c: "Use the materials in the recipe and do good work in the Fun-Sized Forge, and you can make a gold ring +1 or better.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a0b: "If it doesn't come out +1 or better, a reforge orb lets you reforge it without materials.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a58: "If it doesn't come out +1 or better, a reforge orb lets you reforge it without materials.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a15: "When you have a gold ring +1 or better, hand it to me unequipped.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a63: "When you have a gold ring +1 or better, hand it to me unequipped.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a1e: "Please do this for my son! Get me the best gold ring +1 or better!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a6b: "Please do this for my son! Get me the best gold ring +1 or better!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a35: "I want to give my son a gold ring +1 or better for his wedding. Make one with the Fun-Sized Forge.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a42: "Take the gold ore from the chest next to me.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a79: "Oh, I've been waiting! Did you get the gold ring +1 or better?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a83: "What, no? Don't keep me waiting too long!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3aa3: "Thank you. Thanks to you, I'll get to see my son's happy face, and keep my pride as a father.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3aad: "Still, that Fun-Sized Forge is amazing. Making anything... I'm jealous!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ad5: "Red-hot iron! Flying sweat! Hammer clashing on anvil! Now that's a man's work, the smith's trade!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ae3: "We've always built furnaces using the lava heat of Hotto Steppe and lived by hammering ore.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3af0: "This region is rich in ore. If we run short, we can dig anytime, so it's perfect for smithing.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3afd: "Say, you've got a fine body! I have a job for you... Could you gather iron ore?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b12: "What?! Only your body's impressive? What a letdown.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b18: "In youth you should work up a sweat. A lazy one who hates moving never becomes a fine smith.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b32: "Good! That's the answer! Then I'll teach you about digging spots so you can gather ore efficiently!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b3e: "A digging spot is a special place where lots of ore materials can be found. Look for crystal lumps sticking out of the ground.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b7e: "A digging spot is a special place where lots of ore materials can be found. Look for crystal lumps sticking out of the ground.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b4e: "When you find one, take a hammer and dig, dig, dig! With luck, ore will pour out.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b8f: "When you find one, take a hammer and dig, dig, dig! With luck, ore will pour out.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b5c: "The digging spots west of Hotto should yield plenty of iron ore. So, I'm counting on you for iron ore!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b9c: "The digging spots west of Hotto should yield plenty of iron ore. So, I'm counting on you for iron ore!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b72: "Sorry, but please gather iron ore in my place. Easy with a digging spot.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bad: "Oh, you gathered iron ore. Then I'll take it. All right?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bb7: "Oh, you weren't ready! Sorry, sorry. Hotto men are short-tempered. Ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bd5: "...I thought so, but sorry. I miscounted the warehouse stock, and don't need iron ore after all.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3be3: "Sorry to ask and then this. Please keep that iron ore.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bef: "And to make up for it, take a recipe that uses iron ore too!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bf7: "Sorry, truly. But for smiths like us, materials really matter.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c0b: "However skilled, without materials a smith's out of business! Always gather ore.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c18: "If you smith, gather ore. When you see a digging spot on your adventure, dig, dig, dig without hesitation!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c55: "Oh ho ho! They say this steam bath is great for beauty among us Heliodor nobles, you know!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c61: "Though the rather shabby building bothers me... I'm looking forward to it!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c74: "This steam bath is famous for beauty even in Heliodor, but it's rather lacking for me.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c7f: "A lukewarm steam bath like this does nothing for my skin! It wasn't worth the trip!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c8a: "The attendant said it was once a hot steam bath, heated by something called a hellfire stone!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c98: "You there, with the smooth hair! I'll reward you, so get me this hellfire stone!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3caa: "How dare you! Didn't your mama teach you to be kind to ladies?!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cbd: "Oh ho ho! Good answer! I knew from the start you wouldn't refuse!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cc7: "Listen, the hellfire stone is a special stone carried by a monster called Hellfire.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cd1: "Hellfire lives inside Mount Huji. Search every corner and find it!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cdc: "Now! Defeat Hellfire for me and bring back the hellfire stone!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cee: "This steam bath is famous for beauty even in Heliodor, but it's too lukewarm for me.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cfa: "So I want a stone called a hellfire stone, which raises the steam bath's temperature.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d06: "Hellfire on Mount Huji carries that stone, so deliver it to me once you get it!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d16: "Have you defeated Hellfire yet and gotten the hellfire stone?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d21: "Oh my! Taking your time? Do deliver the hellfire stone, will you? I'm short-tempered!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d3b: "So this is the hellfire stone. Oh ho ho! Now the steam bath will be hotter, and my skin will be smooth as silk!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d48: "Honestly, how kind of me. Fetching a hellfire stone for a useless steam bath owner!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d55: "You thought I was like a goddess, didn't you? More! Praise me more!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d5f: "Oh ho ho ho ho! I'm feeling generous with the reward! Here, take it!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d6d: "You really did well. I can't wait to try the hellfire stone. Oh ho ho ho!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dc2: "Oh, handsome. How about a puff-puff? Only 20 gold.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dcb: "Oh, what a shame. If you change your mind, call me again.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dd7: "Oh my, but you don't have enough money. Sorry, but come again.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3df6: "How's that? Nice, right? Puff puff puff... Puff puff puff...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3dfb: "Hee hee. That's all. Thank you very much. Come again.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e0e: "Hee hee. That's all. Thank you very much. Come again.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d2b: "Hey, traveler! Having fun? We can enjoy tonight thanks to you folks. Thank you!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|680a: "Lonalulu Village is a fine place to spend your remaining years. Ho ho ho, a good village.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6814: "Hm? That unfamiliar outfit... You're a traveler. Ho ho ho, wonderful. I traveled the world when I was young too.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6822: "But I've grown old. I plan to settle in Lonalulu Village and spend my remaining years.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|682e: "Seeing you reminds me of my hot-blooded youth. ...Hm, you seem confident in your skill.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|683b: "But skill alone isn't enough. Without climbing the stairs to true adulthood, you won't grow further.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6849: "I learned on my travels: no matter how you hone your skill, without becoming a true adult you can't be first-class.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6857: "Meeting you here is fate. If you wish to grow further, let me set you a trial.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6864: "Far west of here by ship is the Nameless Isle. Defeat the boss troll there with a certain Pep Power.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6872: "Ho ho ho, how about it? Will you take this trial?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|687f: "Ho ho ho. That's fine too. The stairs to true adulthood aren't to be rushed. Come back when you've decided.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6899: "Ho ho ho, good answer. The Pep Power I speak of is called a page of youth.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68ae: "A hint: All-or-nothing... and the other skill is...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68b5: "Ho ho ho, that's all. Understood? Defeat the boss troll on the Nameless Isle with a page of youth.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68c2: "When you return here, you'll surely have grown. I look forward to it.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68f4: "When you return here, you'll surely have grown. I look forward to it.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68d5: "Understood? To climb to true adulthood, beat the boss troll on the Nameless Isle, far west by ship, with a page of youth.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68e7: "This Pep Power is triggered by All-or-nothing and a certain skill. That skill is... ho ho ho, a secret.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6912: "Ho ho ho, depth... that's depth. You finally know, young one. You've begun the stairs to true adulthood.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|691f: "Yes, puff-puff is depth... Depth is puff-puff... What depth brings is a page of youth...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6929: "Youth is knowing. A true adult knows and overcomes. All origins lie in puff-puff...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6935: "Ho ho ho, well done, young one. The stairs to true adulthood go on, but climb one step at a time, unhurried.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6942: "This is from me. Take it without hesitation.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6949: "Come to think of it, decades ago I had a close friend. We traveled everywhere together.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6955: "His name was Chalky. Traveling together, we struggled to become true adults.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|697a: "His name was Chalky. Traveling together, we struggled to become true adults.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|695f: "Strange. Looking at you, his face somehow came to mind. Ho ho ho, why is that?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6985: "Strange. Looking at you, his face somehow came to mind. Ho ho ho, why is that?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|696f: "Decades ago I had a close friend. We traveled everywhere together.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|69a4: "Ha ha, behold this body forged by fishing! Even if monsters attack, they'll run away, I bet!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|69be: "Oh no, where did it go...? If I don't find it, it's only a matter of time before the other fishermen learn the truth...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|69cc: "...Oh, a traveler. Sorry, I'm busy. I've no time for you...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|69dc: "Hey, traveler! Sudden, but help me look for something? I'll thank you, please! Please!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|69f1: "Don't say that! Right now only a traveler from outside the village is my lifeline!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a09: "Th-thank you! Then please look for the old wooden goddess carving I lost.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a13: "I couldn't find it anywhere in the village, so I must have dropped it out fishing.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a4f: "I couldn't find it anywhere in the village, so I must have dropped it out fishing.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a1e: "My last stop on my last fishing trip was the deserted island far north of Lonalulu. The carving must be there.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a5a: "My last stop on my last fishing trip was the deserted island far north of Lonalulu. The carving must be there.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a2f: "If you find the goddess carving, come back here. But keep this secret from the villagers, please.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a6b: "If you find the goddess carving, come back here. But keep this secret from the villagers, please.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a7c: "Oh, traveler, you're back! So... did you find the goddess carving?!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a87: "I-I see. Please find it before the villagers get suspicious of me not fishing!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6aaa: "Ah... aaah! You came back, my dear doll! Thank goodness... I'll never let go of you again!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ab4: "My dear doll... While you were gone, I felt so lonely and sad, as bad as when Mama died.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ac2: "...Oops. I let my guard down and my true self slipped out.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6aca: "Um... please keep this secret from the village fishermen, but this doll is a keepsake from my late mother.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ad6: "I look like this, but I'm such a coward I can't fish alone. With this doll, it feels like Mama's near.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ae5: "This doll's face is just like Mama's smile. When it's hard, I look at it to cheer myself up.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6af2: "Thank you, traveler. Thanks to you finding the doll, I can fish again. Please take this thanks.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b00: "...But like this I'll always be half a man. Mama would laugh at me.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b0b: "Someday I have to fix my cowardice and fish alone, without the keepsake doll...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b1e: "Mama, I'll become a fine, full-fledged fisherman someday, I promise. Until then, watch over me...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b2a: "Whoa! Y-you... Don't startle me. I thought a village mate came.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b4a: "The sea around Lonalulu Village is among the best fishing grounds in Erdrea, plump fish by the bucketful.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b66: "Oh, you. Good timing. Lately we can't catch fish at all, and everyone's going hungry.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b72: "Following the village's old custom, we offered seafood to pray for a good catch, but it has little effect.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b81: "With a catch this bad, ordinary seafood offerings don't satisfy the sea god.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b8d: "I thought a giant kraken tentacle would satisfy the sea god, but we can't beat that beast.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b9a: "So I want you, who've beaten it, to get a giant dried squid from the kraken.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ba5: "At this rate the village will starve. You're our only hope! Please bring a giant dried squid!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bbc: "I see... can't be helped. You have your own business too.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bc2: "But I can do nothing for the hungry, crying children. Damn, what do I do...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bd9: "You'll do it! You saved the fishermen before too, I'm always in your debt!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6be3: "The kraken is said to be in the waters near the East Champs Isle in the Champs Sauvages, north of Lonalulu.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c20: "The kraken is said to be in the waters near the East Champs Isle in the Champs Sauvages, north of Lonalulu.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bf1: "But to turn the kraken into dried squid, you must finish it with the Pep Power Blast slash.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c2e: "But to turn the kraken into dried squid, you must finish it with the Pep Power Blast slash.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bfa: "Blast slash is a Pep Power triggered by using Flame slash and Fire-eater at the same time. Learn it and take on the kraken.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c38: "Blast slash is a Pep Power triggered by using Flame slash and Fire-eater at the same time. Learn it and take on the kraken.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c0a: "Then finish the kraken with Blast slash, get the giant dried squid, and bring it to me. Count on you!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c47: "Then finish the kraken with Blast slash, get the giant dried squid, and bring it to me. Count on you!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c58: "Oh, it's you. That nice smell... did you get the giant dried squid?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c79: "So this is dried kraken! What an enormous size! Nothing like ordinary dried squid!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c82: "Offer this and the sea god's belly will surely be full, and he'll bring the fish back.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c8d: "Ugh... now I won't have to make the children go hungry. Really, really thank goodness...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c97: "Thank you! Lonalulu is a poor village, but let us thank you as best a poor village can!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ca8: "Welcome! We offered the giant dried squid you brought to the sea god properly!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6cb4: "Now fish will surely return to the sea! You're our village's savior! Truly grateful!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6cdb: "...Please leave me alone? Right now I'm crushed by the impermanence of life, standing here alone in the dusk...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6cf5: "I sailed for the legendary crystal lily, but my ship sank, and I washed up in this backwater with nothing...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d08: "With no one to know or rely on, I'll surely end my life alone. Ugh... why did this happen?!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d16: "I must have been born under the unluckiest star in the world. I'd rather die!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d21: "But I wanted to see the legendary crystal lily, just once...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d2a: "Ah, if only some kind person would bring the legendary crystal lily to me...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d3f: "Heh heh... such a convenient person can't exist in this world. I'll just die like this...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d57: "R-really?! ...No! You'll raise my hopes, then betray me cruelly later!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d62: "But... if you truly mean to get the legendary crystal lily, please listen.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d6d: "The legendary crystal lily blooms only on a windswept plateau in Sniflheim, far to the north.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d9a: "The legendary crystal lily blooms only on a windswept plateau in Sniflheim, far to the north.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d7c: "...See, it's so far you're getting tired of it? It's fine, don't force yourself.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d84: "I was going to die anyway. I'll wait, not expecting much, for you to bring the legendary crystal lily...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6db2: "I was going to die anyway. I'll wait, not expecting much, for you to bring the legendary crystal lily...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6da8: "It's far from here, so even if you give up halfway, I won't resent you.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6dc4: "...What, do you have business with me now? You aren't going to say you got the legendary crystal lily, are you?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6dd4: "Ha ha... I knew you'd answer that. I never expected anything from the start.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6df1: "Th-this is truly the legendary crystal lily! To think you'd really fetch it for someone as shabby as me.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6dfe: "Wonderful... The world isn't so bad after all. My hypothesis has been proved.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e09: "I'm sorry for being rude. Actually, I'm a scholar studying human psychology and goodwill.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e17: "With the black sun tilting the world toward evil, I wondered whether selfless goodwill could exist.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e28: "I wanted to believe it could. You proved that wish, my hypothesis, true!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e34: "Thank you... truly thank you. Let me reward you for indulging me.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e44: "You seem to have a heart as pure and clear as the legendary crystal lily. Please stay that way.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e51: "Surely the world gets a little better as people like you influence it.

id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6eec: "...Very well. From my cannon collection I'll bestow the finest piece!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6efa: "When the exhibit starts, I must go see it! I can't wait!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f08: "By the way, which museum will show my cannon?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f0f: "...What? The Nautica National Museum? Never heard of such a country. It must be a very distant museum.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f26: "Surrounded by tall mountains, Hotto long had little contact with other lands and built a unique culture, prospering greatly.

id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f38: "And! They say the treasures of that time still sleep near this village. What a romantic tale!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f63: "Do you know the legend of the scarlet gemstone, hidden by a priestess of the age, still left in Hotto?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f72: "I've sought that legendary treasure since my great-grandfather's time. I am Heehodolf, treasure hunter.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f80: "Decades chasing the legendary treasure... I've searched alone for the scarlet gemstone, but have realized my limit.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f91: "So how about it? Won't you chase the romance of Hotto's hidden treasure with me?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fa5: "A pity. My only goal is the scarlet gemstone, so I'd planned to leave the other treasure to you.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fbe: "Heh heh, as I expected. You too chase romance. This is worth a million allies!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fcd: "First, let's find the ancient priestess's diary said to be kept in this village! It must hold clues to the treasure!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fdd: "If you find the priestess's diary, don't mind me, go seek the treasure!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7022: "If you find the priestess's diary, don't mind me, go seek the treasure!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fe9: "Now! Let's join forces and get Hotto's hidden treasure! Everything but the scarlet gemstone is yours!

id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7002: "Hotto once prospered. I heard its hidden treasure remains today, and have searched for years.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7013: "The clue is the ancient priestess's diary said to be kept in the village. It's the guidepost to the hidden treasure!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7042: "Oh, you're back. How did it go? Did you find Hotto's hidden treasure?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7050: "Hmm... it's not easy. But the day of fulfillment must be near! We will find Hotto's hidden treasure!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7071: "Th-this is Hotto's hidden treasure! At last I can report to my great-grandfather's grave. Ah, I'm overcome!
